verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly documents a Hosted Payment Page — a pre-built, Airwallex-hosted checkout supporting many payment methods with a single integration — plus a quickstart showing an end-to-end payment via the hosted page, and Payment Links for no-code hosted checkout. This directly matches the story of redirecting customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized page without building custom payment UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., third-party reviews) confirming conversion optimization claims beyond vendor docs.
